messages:
Zoe Li: hi everyone, Zoe here  starting today! trying to get my dev sandbox set up. Filled the cloud access form but it errors on Billing Account lookup. Also wondering what default GCP roles new hires get vs what we need to request. :wave:
Caleb Morris: welcome Zoe :tada: for billing the ID needs dashes like `012345-678901-234567`. If the form still fails paste the Billing Account ID and I can attach it manually. We usually give new hires `roles/browser` + `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` by default; ask for compute/admin if you need to create VMs.
Zoe Li: thanks Caleb. Billing ID I tried was `012345678901234567` (no dashes)  my bad. Can I request KMS decrypt for a key in `us` too? Onboarding tutorial needs it.
cloud-admin-bot: Ticket CLOUD-6021 created by caleb for project request `redwood-sandbox-zoe`. ETA: 30m.
Caleb Morris: go ahead and paste the key path and I'll add you to the appropriate group. Also for AWS: we use SSO so you should see the Redwood AWS account in the SSO portal. Dev roles allow `us-west-2` and `eu-west-1` by default. APAC regions need approval.
Zoe Li: key path is `projects/redwood-common/locations/us/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-key`. Also I couldn't find the SSO link in the handbook, where is it?
Rina Sato: hi Zoe  welcome! SSO link is at https://sso.redwood.ai under "Workforce SSO" in the handbook nav. I added you to `onboard-kms-users` for the key and granted `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on that key. You should be able to test with:
```
gcloud kms decrypt --location=us --keyring=onboard --key=onboard-key --ciphertext-file=ct.bin --plaintext-file=pt.bin
```
Zoe Li: tried the gcloud command and got permission denied still  any idea?
Caleb Morris: give it a minute, group adds sometimes take a few mins to propagate. If it persists I'll escalate the IAM change. Also check you're using the `redwood` user in gcloud config: `gcloud config get-value account`.
Zoe Li: yep using zoe.li@redwood.ai and now decrypt worked. Billing attach also succeeded after I fixed the dashes. Thanks y'all! 
Rina Sato: great! Closing CLOUD-6021 once billing fully settles. If you need APAC region access for testing, file a quick request with justification and we'll route to cloud-compliance. Ping #eng-infra for any urgent perms.
Zoe Li: will do. thanks for the fast help :thumbsup:
